the UL0 gene of ILTV is dispensable for viral replication, and that the UL0 locus is suitable for insertion of heterologous genes.
the UL0 gene of ILTV is non-essential for in vitro virus multiplication and for virus replication in vivo, but that it contributes to virulence in chickens.
